narrative.details:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
narrative.objectives: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
narrative.requestItemsText: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.
